variants.name: Tubfalet (Korath Raider (Chaos Hammer))
variants.description: The venerable Palavret has been a mainstay of the Korath raiding fleet, elements of its design dating back from before the era of shortages and desperation caused by a life in exile. Over forty generations of raiders have terrorized neighboring systems over the centuries. 	Constant warfare against surrounding aliens has been building pressure on Korath shipyards to recover some of their ancient prowess. Now, with a fresh industrial network to draw upon, the Korath have created a new raider to deal with modern targets, and the Tubfalet-Class Raiding Ship is named for an admiral who dealt with such enemies. Despite extensive injuries, he remained on his flag bridge during a Remnant attack, leading his squadron to victory.

variants.name: Prefect's Albatross (Albatross (Night Sword))
variants.description: Once they left human space, it became apparent to the Remnant that they would need to build their own shipyards in order to defend themselves if they were discovered by the Alphas or any other unfriendly faction. Using new composite materials that they discovered, they built ships very different from anything seen in human space. The wings of this Albatross sweep back, giving it a sleek appearance. This marks it as a Prefect's Albatross, used on the rare occasion when a Prefect isn't riding on a cloaked ship.

variants.name: Marauder Kestrel (Kestrel (Bloodwind))
variants.description: Several years ago, while visiting a sweat lodge in search of spiritual renewal, Tarazed's chief ship designer fell into a trance and journeyed to a reality separate from our own. There he saw visions of a strange and elegant starship. Returning to his work with renewed purpose, he spent the next seven years making the Kestrel a reality.

variants.name: Archon (Surveillance)
variants.description: The Archon's presence is chilling. The "ship" has an almost organic appearance, but your ship's scanners give you no discernible information on its construction. What exactly it is you do not know, but you can feel that it is powerful.

variants.name: Albatross (Gravedigger)
variants.description: Once they left human space, it became apparent to the Remnant that they would need to build their own shipyards in order to defend themselves if they were discovered by the Alphas or any other unfriendly faction. variants.name: Starling (Gravedigger)
variants.description: One of the strangest and most useful things that the Remnant have discovered in the abandoned worlds of the Ember Waste is alien cloaking technology. They have designed their scout ships to cloak when needed in order to explore alien territory without being seen... or to escape in a hurry after stealing something particularly valuable from those aliens. 	The cloaking technology is built into the Starling's hull; it cannot be removed or transferred to another ship.

variants.name: Gull (Gravedigger)
variants.description: While the Starling was the first successful ship to use technology derived from alien ruins, the Gull is the most recent. The current increase in Korath activities has caused foraging for resources to become a risky endeavor, forcing the Remnant to develop a specialized freighter for hauling cargo from remote sites without revealing their presence to hostile aliens. 	The Gull has quickly proven its worth, allowing the Starling fleets to return to riskier activities while the Gull takes over the hazardous convoy routes. It is now the primary element of the Remnant's extra-territorial resource operations. 	The cloaking technology is built into the Gull's hull; it cannot be removed or transferred to another ship.

variants.name: Penguin (Gravedigger)
variants.description: Inspired by close contact with void sprites and the reinvigoration of xenobiology, the Penguin is a prototype designed to serve the dual roles of testing new starship technology while exploring hostile planets throughout the Ember Waste. One of this ship's distinguishing features is that it is truly alive and has a mind that approaches self-awareness. 	The cloaking technology is built into the Penguin's hull; it cannot be removed or transferred to another ship.

variants.name: Pelican (disarmed)
variants.description: The Pelican is closely based on the original semi-organic materials the Remnant found in the Ember Waste. While they are not technically alive, their internal mechanisms and method of construction bear such a close resemblance to living organisms that they are often considered as such. One key feature of this living resemblance is the innate sensory capabilities they possess, akin to sensor suites less advanced ships require for detailed scanning. These ships serve as the backbone of Remnant bulk salvage efforts, as well as their fast-logistics distribution network.

variants.name: Kvelqde-Khora (Nefa Coilguns)
variants.description: One of the more industrious members of the People's Houses has done their best to ruggedize this Kvelqde: additional armor plating has been laid over most of the exposed hull, a second gun port has been attached to the underside, and the shield grid has had its capacity substantially increased. While not quite capable of standing toe-to-toe with a production interceptor of the High Houses, it bares enough teeth for a bit of light piracy, and its greater durability is quite welcome for navigating the decaying stations and hostile worlds of southwestern Successor space.

variants.name: Stolsaqra (Fajet Coilguns)
variants.description: The Successors have limited experience in making warships this small, and while their attempt at an interceptor is durable and sports a surprising amount of firepower for a ship of its size, it is also plagued with power and propulsion issues, as most of their standard technology is either too large or not powerful enough to yield effective combat performance at this scale. The result is a ship that ambitious pilots call a challenge and prudent captains call a deathtrap, but that continues to see use as a patrol and escort vessel because of its speed and heavy armament. 	The Stolsaqra also has the distinction of being the only purpose-built warship manufactured by the High Houses that is made available to the general public, albeit with significantly downgraded systems compared to the military-exclusive model.

variants.name: Myaede (Nefa Coilguns)
variants.description: The Myaede is neither elegant nor fast, but it has remained the mainstay of Successor commerce since before the collapse of the old empire over a thousand years ago, boasting a spacious cargo hold, heavy armor, and a flexible enough weapons layout to let it fight back in a pinch. Much like the grand heirlooms of the High Houses, a familial Myaede is often passed down through the lineage of spacefaring low-born Successors, and many of the pilots flying these first took the helm as children under a grandparent's watchful gaze.

outfits.name: Pyrite
outfits.description: Also known as Fool's Gold, Pyrite is a common component in the manufacture of photovoltaic panels. It is also used in magnetic data storage technologies and non-rechargeable batteries.

outfits.name: Quantum Bloodcore
outfits.description: There is some speculation that Bloodcores only form from supernovas that resulted in the deaths of billions of sentient lifeforms. The presence of Quantumium in the system prior to the supernova may also be a prerequisite. But there is no way to test this hypothesis without actually witnessing a supernova take place in a system with those features and observing the result, which could take several millenia to crystallize.

outfits.name: Quantumium
outfits.description: The raw ore used to make Quantum Keystones. Since it has not been processed, it occupies more space than a Quantum Keystone does.

outfits.name: Deuterium
outfits.description: Deuterium is normally harvested from the cloudy atmospheres of gas giants. However, it can also be found frozen in the icy cores of wandering comets.

outfits.name: Fossil
outfits.description: An alien fossil found in the void of space. Unless you can find the right buyer, most will only see a cheap trinket that can be sold as a souvenir to gullible tourists. 	This is a rare relic. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Mysterious Treasure
outfits.description: The old stories of pirates burying treasure in some out of the way dirt clod are true! While you can sell it anywhere for a modest sum, having it appraised by someone with knowledge of rare artifacts may yield better results. 	This may be a rare artifact. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Earth Artifact
outfits.description: This is an artifact from Earth's distant past with some historical significance. You can sell it for a decent sum. 	This is a rare artifact. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Alien Artifact
outfits.description: This is an artifact from an unknown alien civilization that once occupied what is now human space. You can sell it for a significant sum! 	This is a rare artifact. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Krypton
outfits.description: Krypton is used in nuclear fusion energy research and experimental particle physics.

outfits.name: Radon
outfits.description: Radon is used in some radiation cancer therapies. Ironically, due to its radioactive properties, it is also a carcinogen.

outfits.name: Xenon
outfits.description: Xenon is the preferred propellant used by Ion Engines since it is more environmentally friendly and less corrosive than other alternatives.

outfits.name: Hackerz Plugin Omega
outfits.description: Installing this onto a ship should allow you to install one outfit that normally could not be installed due to reinstall. 	This cannot be uninstalled while the other outfit is installed, so use this with caution.

outfits.name: Hackerz Plugin Alpha
outfits.description: Installing this onto a ship should allow you to uninstall one outfit that normally could not be uninstalled due to integrated systems or fused circuits. 	This cannot be uninstalled unless the other outfit is installed, so use this with caution.

outfits.name: Hackerz Plugin Sigma
outfits.description: Installing this onto a ship disables its spinal mount. Why anyone would do this is unknown. 	This cannot be installed onto a ship that doesn't have a spinal mount or if something is already installed in its spinal mount.

outfits.name: Popcorn Box
outfits.description: A box filled with golden buttery popcorn to enjoy while watching a story unfold. 	Certain rare missions are more likely to trigger while this is installed on your flagship.

outfits.name: Rusty Asteroid Scanner
outfits.description: This rusty old asteroid scanner may look like junk, but it still works. Unfortunately the effective range is so low you might not realize an asteroid is minable until you're practically on top of it.

outfits.name: Emergency Repair Kit
outfits.description: This is a set of tools and spare material for repairing the hull. While impractical for use while engaged in combat, a ship with this installed can be repaired while landed on a planet that lacks hull repair services.

outfits.name: Gremlin Circuits
outfits.description: Some fused circuits from when you salvaged parts to make the Gremlin. You never got around to fixing it, but they're not connected to anything important so it should be fine...

outfits.name: Food?
outfits.description: This is barely edible, but it should be able to keep you going for another day.

outfits.name: Voidjelly
outfits.description: Voidjellies are poisonous and have almost no commercial value. They are, however, a favorite food of certain large Voidfish that are immune to the toxin. A high enough concentration of them within a water droplet is likely to attract a Voidlunker.

outfits.name: Voidlunker
outfits.description: Occasionally, a voidborne fish grows to a particularly large size. These lunkers are highly prized among a small community of fishing enthusiasts. Such specimens are preserved through a process, similar to taxidermy, for display in private collections. 	This is a rare catch. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Murkfish
outfits.description: Most of the voidborne fish found in the dark waters of Murk appear even more alien than those caught in Gossamer. This exotic appearance is enhanced by a larger representation of species exhibiting some form of bioluminescence.

outfits.name: Rotting Murk Flesh
outfits.description: A chunk of rotting flesh found scattered through out the waters of Murk. The size and shape suggest these came from something larger than a capital ship... 	The flesh itself is too far gone to have any market value, but it is teeming with crustaceans, mollusks, and other small invertebrates feeding upon it. These scavengers seem like they might be edible if cooked properly.

outfits.name: Wither Wood
outfits.description: Underneath the tree's rotting exterior, Wither Wood shines with an unearthly glow. The bio-matter has been imbued with high levels of radioactive uranium. Whether natural evolution or artificial bio-engineering caused this is a mystery. Some may find this substance useful as an alternative energy source or weapons development material. But it probably wouldn't be a good idea to sell these at a concerts as glow sticks.

outfits.name: Orange Optical Laser
outfits.description: The three lasers mounted on this heavy turret are effective at smelting asteroids and harvesting other interstellar resources. They also generate more heat than most other Avgi lasers, both on the ship they are installed on as well as any ship they strike. An optical lasing generator is integrated into the weapon, contributing to its considerable size and weight.

outfits.name: Speck Magazine Depot
outfits.description: The Speck Magazine Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Speck Rounds. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Deflector Lamina
outfits.description: These shield emitters can be mounted conformally to a ship's hull, adding to the shield coverage of the hull surface by half. This causes the shield generators to work harder than they normally would, doubling all resource requirements to restore lost shields. 	Deflector Laminae take advantage of special external hardpoints built into most Avgi ships, allowing them to be mounted without taking up any outfit space. However, they also tend to increase the amount of heat absorbed from the local star.

outfits.name: Harvester Scanner
outfits.description: This compact scanner is configured to assist short range data collection for Void Harvesters instead of providing long range tactical data.

outfits.description: While wearing this pendant, the Avgi will recognize you as a competent Void Harvester and offer you access to their more specialized harvesting tools and ships. 	The tiny Voidfish dangling from the chain looks remarkably life-like. Shaking it back and forth makes it appear as if it's trying to slip off a fishing hook.

outfits.name: Bunrodean Artifact License
outfits.description: The outfitter occasionally shows off rare artifacts that aren't actually for sale.

outfits.description: The Swarm Clip Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Swarm Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Thermal Insulator
outfits.description: The Bunrodea learned that Korath ships are susceptible to overheating and developed this device to exacerbate that weakness on ships that tried to board them. Thermal Insulators reduce the cooling efficiency of any ship they are installed on. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Lasher Rifle
outfits.description: Unlike modern Lasher Pistols, this weapon utilizes brutally savage design principles more suitable for attack than defense. It is a testament to a less civilized era in Bunrodean antiquity.

outfits.name: Heliarch Corruption
outfits.description: Evidence of corrupt activities involving a Heliarch official.

outfits.name: Camouflaged Blaster
outfits.description: Someone redesigned an old Energy Cannon to resemble a Coalition Model Cannon. The outer casing incorporates scanning interference material to help conceal its internal circuitry. These weapons are popular with both criminals and dissidents within the Coalition, allowing them to covertly arm their ships without drawing attention from the Heliarchs.

outfits.name: Coalition Attractor
outfits.description: Coalition Attractors played a pivotal role in the Saryd's ability to control early battles against the Quarg. Heliarch technicians would later refine this technology into a more powerful weapon.

outfits.name: Coalition Repulsor
outfits.description: Coalition Repulsors allowed Saryd escorts to keep enemy ships away from vulnerable targets. However, they lack some of the features that the Heliarch would later develop when enhancing this technology.

outfits.name: Deflector Emitter
outfits.description: The Deflector Emitter was an accidental invention that came about during the development of the Heliarch Repulsor. It supplements shield coverage over the ship, helping to protect it from asteroids or other debris. 	In addition to occupying a turret mount, each emitter installed will increase stress on the shield generators, raising consumption of resources used to replenish your shields.

outfits.name: Model Cannon
outfits.description: This Model Cannon is a non-functional representation of an actual Bombardment Cannon. Civilian ship collectors in the Coalition use these to decorate their ships for added aesthetic authenticity.

outfits.name: Culminator Pod
outfits.description: Culminator Torpedoes are an antique design that eventually lead to development of the modern Finishers in use by the Heliarch. Old forgotten weapons caches of these are sometimes found hidden throughout Coalition space. 	Unlike Finishers, Culminators launch hot. This shortens their range since they burn out more quickly.

outfits.name: Culminator Storage Tube
outfits.description: Culminator Storage Tubes are more compact than Finisher Storage Tubes, but lack the additional energy storage capacity of its modern counterpart.

outfits.name: Culminator Storage Depot
outfits.description: The Culminator Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Culminator Torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Culminator Torpedo
outfits.description: This extremely powerful missile is ammunition for the Coalition Culminator Pod. Not as maneuverable as a Finisher Torpedo and equipped with simpler tracking technology, a Culminator strike is still as destructive as that of their modern equivalents.

outfits.name: Finisher Storage Depot
outfits.description: The Finisher Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Finisher Torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Coalition Scanner
outfits.description: This antique scanner is far less powerful than the Scanning Modules used by the Heliarchs, but it has additional features more suitable for exploration and research.

The Fuel Dissipator works by tapping into the fuel system of the ship it is installed on and inducing a leak. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Coalition Reactor Cluster
outfits.description: Coalition Reactor Clusters are less modular than their modern Heliarch equivalents.

outfits.name: Riot Containment Barrier
outfits.description: A simple crowd control barrier made from the same durable alloys found in spaceship hulls. Easy to set up and difficult to break through, they can be surprisingly effective at blocking passage through the corridors of a ship. 	While Riot Containment Barriers are typically deployed by the Heliarchs to keep civil unrest under control, these are technically not weapons. A growing market of citizens concerned about dissidents is starting to have these installed on their ships.

outfits.name: Saryd Light Lance
outfits.description: This lance is a traditional Saryd hunting weapon that is rarely seen outside of the Coalition Games during the modern era. Private ownership of these weapons are strictly regulated and monitored by the Heliarchs. 	The tip of this spear charges and holds an energy bolt that can be used to enhance the wielder's strikes in melee or be flung at an enemy from a distance.

outfits.name: Ignus-Lance
outfits.description: The Ignus-Lance is a short-range beam weapon that inflicts intense heat damage to anything it strikes.

outfits.name: Combustion Torpedo
outfits.description: Combustion Torpedoes are ammunition for the Combustion Launcher. Each Combustion Launcher can hold 27 of them. You cannot install torpedoes unless you have also installed a launcher to fire them from.

outfits.name: Combustion Storage Rack
outfits.description: The Combustion Storage Rack is used to store extra ammunition for Combustion Launchers.

outfits.name: Combustion Depot
outfits.description: The Combustion Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Combustion Torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Combustion Launcher
outfits.description: Combustion Torpedoes create a small nuclear reaction that irradiates the target with residual heat after the initial impact. The infrared tracking makes it easier for subsequent torpedoes to find their target.

outfits.name: Solar Scoop
outfits.description: These simple ramscoops provide fuel for several Ignitian outfits.

outfits.name: Blood Drive
outfits.description: Somehow, the technological development of the Ignitia skipped the Hyperdrive and leaped directly to a rudimentary Jump Drive. While this device is limited to travel along hyperspace lanes, it is clear that their researchers are on course to figuring out how to make true Jump Drives.

outfits.name: Bloodstone Drive
outfits.description: The workings of the jump drive are a total mystery. The best that human scientists have been able to find out is that this device is a containment field for matter in a state that cannot normally exist in this universe; if the drive is opened up, the field collapses and its contents disappear. Therefore, even though a few jump drives have been captured over the years, it has so far proved impossible to reverse engineer them. 	This Jump Drive is manufactured with special materials that give it a quality which regular Jump Drives lack.

outfits.name: Cauldron Core
outfits.description: The Ignitia seem to regard the Cauldron Core with a sense of mysticism. Maintaining it involves the performance of rituals which do not appear to have any relation to its generated output.

outfits.name: Crucible Core
outfits.description: The Ignitia seem to regard the Crucible Core with a sense of mysticism. Maintaining it involves the performance of rituals which do not appear to have any relation to its generated output.

outfits.name: Rubicon Capacitor
outfits.description: These crystals can store a surprising amount of power in a compact form. They are easily found on Ignus, the Ignitia homeworld. 	The capacitors tend to leak small amounts of energy but are well suited to absorbing heat.

outfits.name: Ignitian Engines
outfits.description: The Ignitia incorporate afterburners into every engine design. Separating them is an alien concept that they find incomprehensible.

outfits.name: Justicar Executar License
outfits.description: Justicar Code of Conduct Statute 0066 Subsection 6 paragraph 6: 	Only Executars appointed by the Justicar Court may purchase equipment sold at Justicar outfitters.

outfits.name: Injunction Gun
outfits.description: Injunction Guns are the simplest weapons wielded by the Justicars.

outfits.name: Injunction Cannon
outfits.description: Injunction Cannons generate concussive blasts that knock perpetrators away from your ship.

outfits.name: Injunction Turret
outfits.description: Injunction Cannons generate concussive blasts that knock perpetrators away from your ship. This weapon features a single Injunction Cannon mounted on a rotating turret mount.

outfits.name: Deliberation Shielding
outfits.description: This shield generator requires some time to activate before recharging the shields. Altering this device for continuous operation was forbidden under Justicar laws against wasteful energy use and heat pollution.

outfits.name: Reparation System
outfits.description: This hull repair system requires some time to activate before repairing the hull. Altering this device for continuous operation was forbidden under Justicar laws against wasteful energy use and heat pollution.

outfits.name: Interrogation Scanner
outfits.description: This Justicar device is one tool used to ensure that the Justicar Code of Conduct is adhered to within their territory.

outfits.name: Incarceration Cell
outfits.description: The harshest punishment in Justicar society is lifetime imprisonment in an Incarceration Cell. The convicts are kept in cryo stasis, unconscious to the world around them. An emergency cooling system powered by the occupant's own life force activates if the cell is exposed to high temperatures. 	Most civilized species view this type of punishment as a form of cruel slavery.

outfits.name: Large Incarceration Cell
outfits.description: This newer model Incarceration Cell was made possible by a alternative source of convicts. Unfortunately, supplies are low. The Executars are investigating these suspects to help improve the rate of prosecutions. 	Most civilized species view this type of punishment as a form of cruel slavery.

outfits.name: Jurisdiction Core
outfits.description: Authority is meaningless without the power to enforce it. This fission reactor provides the Justicar with the power to wield their tools of lawfare.

outfits.name: Continuance Engine
outfits.description: Justicar engines are a hybrid of ion and plasma technology. While maneuverable, their maximum potential speed is slow.

outfits.name: Movant Engine

outfits.name: Railgun Slug Depot
outfits.description: The Railgun Slug Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Railgun Slugs. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Hai Heliotrope Regenerator
outfits.description: Heliotrope Regenerators have carried legendary warriors though the bloodiest of conflicts. However, the extreme heat it generates proved disastrous when the Hai faced an enemy prepared to abuse that weakness. Now, only the most courageous of the True Hai dare to install this on their ships.

outfits.name: Ion Pulse Shotgun
outfits.description: A weapon stolen from Farpoint's evidence vault, this appears to be a heavily modified Hai Pulse Rifle. Twin barrels fire a pair of ion pulse blasts that collide as they rush towards the target, bursting into a spread that affects a wide area. Mechanical weapons caught in the blast temporarily become inoperable. Ironically, due to the intensity of the recoil, smaller species such as the Hai may find this weapon difficult to wield.

outfits.name: Quantum Dragon Blade
outfits.description: This Quantum Key Blade is an ancient Hai artifact from the era when their people still waged war on other alien races across the galaxy. The blade is forged from a single Quantum Key Stone of the highest quality. A design of the micro circuitry in the hand grip, the technological secrets of which have been lost to antiquity, sends a charge through the blade that alters the wielder's quantum alignment, granting the ability to walk through walls or other solid matter. The hand guard has an intricate carving of a dragon on it. Holding it fills you with a sense of determination.

TriggeredByMissionEvents: "QKBlade: Bearer of The Blade 2" → event "Stolen Snake Blade"

outfits.name: Broadband Amplifier
outfits.description: An artifact from the early era of space exploration, a Broadband Amplifier improves the range of your existing cargo and outfit scanners. However, this also increases the amount of time required to complete those scans. It is primarily found on science vessels for which maintaining a safe distance from dangerous intersellar phenomena is more relevant than quickly scanning ships for contraband or tactical information. 	This device cannot be installed on a ship that doesn't already have equipment for scanning both cargo and outfits.

outfits.name: Engineering Room
outfits.description: An Engineering Room acts as a centralized control center for managing repairs and regulating the flow of energy on your ship. This can make energy usage by certain outfits more efficient while also alleviating effects that negatively impact your ship. A skilled engineering crew who understands how these systems work and interact with each other is essential to Engineering Room operations. 	Engineering Rooms are also often the location where a ship's self-destruct sequence is activated. Typically it involves deliberately causing a reactor meltdown in the ship's power systems or some similar catastrophic failure. At a minimum, this usually requires the cooperation of both the captain and the engineering crew.

outfits.name: Limit Breaker
outfits.description: This outfit is sometimes referred to as the "Berserker Circuit" after the first ship it was used in. Many consider the development of this device a reckless attempt to push a ship's combat abilities to its maximum limits. But installing a Limit Breaker on your ship allows it to keep functioning well past the point that it would be disabled due to internal safety mechanisms shutting your systems down. 	Installing more than one of these outfits reduces their effectiveness as they interfere with each other as well as your ship's internal safety shutdown systems.

outfits.name: Liquid Metal Hull
outfits.description: Made with Korath nanomachine technology. Its ability to regenerate itself is unparalleled. 	This hull can reshape itself, making it compatible with a variety of hull technologies.

outfits.name: Modified D14-RN Shielding
outfits.description: The D14-RN Shield Generator is the standard shield generator for fighters and interceptors, as well as for many non-combat starships. Although it is possible for a ship to have no shield generator at all, recharging its shield matrix only when landed in a hospitable spaceport, life in deep space is unpredictable enough that most pilots find shield generators to be well worth the space they take up. 	Modifications to this outfit have increased its rate of shield generation. However it consumes considerably more energy while also generating heat as a result of being pushed to perform beyond the intended specifications it was designed for. Note that these after market alterations voids the manufacturer's warranty.

outfits.name: Modified D41-HY Shielding
outfits.description: The D41-HY Shield Generator is a more powerful shield generator designed for ships that are likely to see frequent combat, or that have such a large shield capacity that recharging them would take a long time with a smaller generator. 	Modifications to this outfit have increased its rate of shield generation. However it consumes considerably more energy while also generating heat as a result of being pushed to perform beyond the intended specifications it was designed for. Note that these after market alterations voids the manufacturer's warranty.

outfits.description: The D67-TM Shield Generator is powerful enough that in combat against some particularly weak ships, they may not even be capable of depleting your shields as fast as they recharge. 	Modifications to this outfit have increased its rate of shield generation. However it consumes considerably more energy while also generating heat as a result of being pushed to perform beyond the intended specifications it was designed for. Note that these after market alterations voids the manufacturer's warranty.

outfits.name: Modified D94-YV Shielding
outfits.description: The D94-YV Shield Generator is the most powerful shield generator available in human space. Because of their large size, D94-YV shield generators are mostly used in large warships, but you can fit one in a smaller ship if you are willing to sacrifice engine power or weaponry to make space for it. 	Modifications to this outfit have increased its rate of shield generation. However it consumes considerably more energy while also generating heat as a result of being pushed to perform beyond the intended specifications it was designed for. Note that these after market alterations voids the manufacturer's warranty.

outfits.description: This hyperdrive has been modified to be more fuel efficient, allowing a ship to conserve fuel for long journeys. 	Rumors speculate that these Modified Hyperdrives are artifacts discovered in alien ruins on a planet in the Northern Frontier. There's no evidence to support such claims, but the list of humans who understand the inner workings of the hyperdrive is short and none of them have stepped forward to take credit for creating this.

outfits.name: H6 Refrigeration Module
outfits.description: As a cooling device, this prototype refrigeration module is a complete failure at preventing spoilage of food and other perishables that require cold storage. But there is another potential use for it. The energy feedback generated when it activates can be utilized for powering other systems on a ship. Despite the steam rising off of its surface, you're certain using it this way won't cause it to blow up. Probably.

outfits.name: LCT-2 Photovoltaic Rod
outfits.description: Light Conductor Technologies most successful product was also their first one: a rod extending out from the hull which cut down on the internal space requirements for installing photovoltaic panels. This lead the company to produce increasingly larger versions of the same product rather than research alternative technologies. 	This array has two photovoltaic panels mounted on it. Some of the energy collected is lost as it is transferred into the ship.

outfits.description: The cost to benefit ratio of their weight and power output was something Light Conductor Technologies strived to improve in their later designs. Yet it was not enough to keep up with the technical advancements of their competitors. 	This array has four photovoltaic panels mounted on it. Some of the energy collected is lost as it is transferred into the ship.

outfits.name: LCT-6 Photovoltaic Staff
outfits.description: This was the last photovoltaic array developed by Light Conductor Technologies before the company went bankrupt. Unofficial duplicates of their products are still manufactured in some remote areas of the galaxy even though the original business no longer exists. 	This array has six photovoltaic panels mounted on it. Some of the energy collected is lost as it is transferred into the ship.

outfits.description: This radiothermal generator has been modified to greatly increase its energy output. But these alterations have resulted in it producing an incredibly high amount of heat. Using this can be dangerous: if allowed to overheat it can create power surges that ignite electrical fires, causing internal damage to the ship it is installed on. 	Some claim that the technique used to make these modified radiothermals originated from stolen research data regarding one of Tarazed's failed experiments. Whenever asked about this topic, the company always denies the validity of such rumors.

outfits.name: QT-800 Nucleovoltaic
outfits.description: Nucleovoltaic generators are a relatively recent generator technology that harvests energy from the decay of a radioisotope source and converts it directly into electricity. They are the most powerful generator that relies on nuclear decay instead of an active nuclear chain reaction. 	Tarazed's research into Quarg technology has had some unexpected findings. This prototype generator, for example, is able to achieve a significantly higher power output than the Nucleovoltaics produced by Deep Sky. Yet it is unable to do so consistently. Testing results reveal a pattern of energy spikes accompanying incidents when the test ship was overheating. However the reason for this has yet to be solved, baffling even Tarazed's most knowledgeable scientists.

EventOutfitterChanges: Adds to "Arachne Station" via event "arachne station tarazed laboratory outfitter"

outfits.name: TP036q Battery Pack
outfits.description: A ship can run without batteries if its generator's instantaneous power output is higher than the total energy consumption of its systems, but batteries make it possible to store up energy when it is not needed and thus to use a much smaller and cheaper generator. 	Research on Quarg technology has enabled Tarazed to develop this higher capacity battery. Unfortunately, it becomes unstable when exposed to high temperatures, losing its ability to retain the energy stored within. Insufficient generators can result in a cascade failure that can drain other batteries.

EventOutfitterChanges: Adds to "Arachne Station" via event "arachne station tarazed laboratory outfitter"

outfits.name: TP072q Battery Pack
outfits.description: This battery pack has more than twice the energy capacity of the most basic model, allowing your ship to engage in combat for longer periods of time before running out of energy. Some pilots have even been known to install these in lieu of any generator at all, trusting that they can reach their destination planet and recharge before running out of battery power, but that is a risky proposition. 	Research on Quarg technology has enabled Tarazed to develop this higher capacity battery. Unfortunately, it becomes unstable when exposed to high temperatures, losing its ability to retain the energy stored within. Insufficient generators can result in a cascade failure that can drain other batteries.

Research on Quarg technology has enabled Tarazed to develop this higher capacity battery. Unfortunately, it becomes unstable when exposed to high temperatures, losing its ability to retain the energy stored within. Insufficient generators can result in a cascade failure that can drain other batteries.

outfits.name: Archaic Afterburner
outfits.description: The original manufacturer of this Archaic Afterburner has been long forgotten. However, it has been preserved in remarkably good condition for its age. 	An afterburner works by dumping hyperspace fuel into your engines and igniting it, producing a large amount of thrust. This can be very useful for dodging missiles or briefly escaping from faster opponents, but you must be careful to avoid using up so much fuel that you do not have enough left for hyperspace travel.

outfits.name: DFN-53 Android
outfits.description: While these were once considered cutting-edge outfits, their lack of autonomous capabilities and economic benefit ensured they were never licensed by a manufacturer. 	Despite this, some captains commissioned these directly from their inventor. This defense android does little to assist with shipboard operations. Instead, it was programmed to protect the ship from hostile boarders. Unfortunately, it quickly becomes disoriented when forced to fight in unfamiliar territory, preventing it from being effective outside of your ship.

outfits.description: A pair of rare Modified Blaster Pistols. A person could burn through a lot of charger packs with these.

outfits.name: Execution Chamber
outfits.description: This is a specially designed room which can be installed in your ship. Anyone who boards you in an attempt to take over your ship will find themselves locked in this room by the self sealing doors. A pair of small portholes allow your crew to safely sweep the chamber with weapons fire from the other side of the reinforced bulkhead.

outfits.name: Purger Rifle
outfits.description: Purger Rifles are sometimes used as part of clandestine biohazard containment protocols. They fire Euthanasia rounds which ensure a quick and painless death for anyone unfortunate enough to be infected with experimental pathogens. Each rifle comes with four additional magazines to ensure an uninterrupted dispersal of mercy. A hollow point injector attachment holds additional inoculations for virulent infestations that enter melee range.

outfits.description: The Tactical Laser Rifle adds a spare battery pack, allowing for longer combat engagements. Its sturdier frame also requires less regular maintenance and protects the internal components if the wielder opts to use this as a bludgeoning weapon. For the additional cost, these benefits are widely considered to be negligible for non-military use.

outfits.name: Blaster Charger
outfits.description: A charger pack for a Blaster Pistol. You might win a special prize if you bring this to Bailey in the Citadelle system and survive the Puppetmaster's challenge...

outfits.name: Contraband
outfits.description: Illegal merchandise found in a smuggler's cargo bay. You might be able to sell it for a profit if the authorities haven't caught you with it first.

outfits.name: Drone Hacking
outfits.description: "How to Hack a Science Drone For Fun and Profit." This guidebook instructs the reader on how to abuse the cargo scan fining system by hacking into a drone's scanners when boarding the drone. Contrary to the title, it works on any drone set up for scanning cargo or outfits. One important detail buried in the text is that the drone must not be hostile towards you. outfits.name: Syndicate Bond (Titania)
outfits.description: This bond certifies a loan to the Syndicate for one billion credits. Ten years after being issued, bond holders can reclaim the one billion credit principal plus an additional five hundred million credits interest payment at Syndicate outfitters. 	This bond was issued to fund the creation of Titania Station in the Eteron system. Once the Syndicate has enough funding for this project, these bonds will no longer be available.

outfits.name: Syndicate Stock (Common)
outfits.description: This certificate represents ownership of one share of Syndicate common stock. Common stock grants no voting power in shareholder elections, but shareholders can still receive dividend payments. 	After the destruction of the Galactic Stock Exchange, the Syndicate began buying and selling shares of their corporate common stock through outfitters on worlds under their control.

outfits.name: Alien Torture Device
outfits.description: A machine assembled from scavenged parts that appear to be alien in origin. It creates a burst of energy that causes extreme pain. While not harmful enough to kill its victims, this device can be used to torture captured defenders until they reveal the codes for bypassing a ship's internal security locks.

Missions: Ship Sale: Modified Argosy (Screams of Madness)

outfits.name: Almachian Brain Maggots
outfits.description: A jar of writhing alien worms. After one is inserted into the victim's ear, there are several moments of agonizing pain and suffering before the victim dies. While not a practical combat weapon, the threat of being tortured to death by these creatures is often enough to persuade a captured crew member to give up the security codes for bypassing the ship's internal door locks.

Missions: Ship Sale: Modified Argosy (Screams of Insanity)

outfits.name: Balthazar Model
outfits.description: A 1/100th scale model of the District ship, Balthazar. Some assembly required.

outfits.name: Biohazard Gas
outfits.description: This illegal weapon designed for hand-to-hand combat seems to have been developed through experiments using the gas produced by Pug Biodefenses on unwilling human test subjects.

outfits.name: Carabao AI
outfits.description: This computer regulates all of the automated systems on the Carabao city ship.

outfits.name: Catapult Schematics
outfits.description: The schematics for the Asteroid Catapult that was installed on the Thermopylae space battle station. Without a skilled engineer willing to actually make one, these are just pictures on a computer screen.

outfits.name: Cloaking Device (Damaged)
outfits.description: You're sure the cloaking device is here somewhere. You can't see it, but you can feel the heat it is generating.

outfits.name: CRG-0 Android
outfits.description: While these were once considered cutting-edge outfits, their lack of autonomous capabilities and economic benefit ensured they were never licensed by a manufacturer. 	Despite this, some captains commissioned these directly from their inventor. This cargo android does little to assist with most shipboard operations. Instead, it was programmed to load cargo bays with a focus on making effective use of the available space, allowing more cargo to be crammed onto a ship. However, this can make retrieving a specific package more difficult than some would consider worth the effort.

"Midnight Phoenix Station Defense Job" → event "phoenix station defense job"

outfits.name: Fake Coffin
outfits.description: This box appears to be a coffin. However its inner surface is lined with a material similar to interference plating. Only the most cold hearted investigator with a strong stomach would dare open it up to inspect the contents.

outfits.name: Guncraft I
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. This particular one has been kept in perfect condition. The basic model has a well balanced grip and precision sigting, but you've heard rumors of gunsmiths who possess the knowledge and skill to make parts modifications that could transform it into a terrifying weapon.

outfits.name: Guncraft II
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features an improved rifled barrel, increasing the weapon's range.

outfits.name: Guncraft III
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features a larger magazine for more ammo.

outfits.name: Guncraft IV
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features a laser guided tactical aim assist system, displaying range data while also marking the target.

outfits.name: Guncraft V
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features a magnetic rail launching system, eliminating the need for gunpowder. This requires the gun to be charged by your ship's systems regularly. 	Mag-rail Slugs aren't sold in shops, requiring you to modify regular bullets instead. This adds a small operating cost to the Guncraft to ensure you have a steady supply of ammunition.

outfits.name: Guncraft VI
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	A magnetic rail launching system eliminates the need for gunpowder but requires the gun to be charged by your ship's systems regularly. 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features heat resistant magazines as a safety precaution in case the ammunition explodes prematurely. 	Detonator Rounds aren't sold in shops, requiring you to modify regular bullets instead. This adds a small operating cost to the Guncraft to ensure you have a steady supply of ammunition.

outfits.name: Guncraft VII
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	A magnetic rail launching system eliminates the need for gunpowder but requires the gun to be charged by your ship's systems regularly. 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features an ionic resistant firing mechanism to prevent it from being affected by its own ammunition. 	Ionic Rounds aren't sold in shops, requiring you to modify regular bullets instead. This adds a small operating cost to the Guncraft to ensure you have a steady supply of ammunition.

outfits.name: Guncraft VIII
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The work of several elite weaponsmiths have turned it into a terrifying weapon... 	A magnetic rail launching system eliminates the need for gunpowder but requires the gun to be charged by your ship's systems regularly. 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features radioactive shielding to protect the wielder from its ammunition. 	Atomic Bullets aren't sold in shops, requiring you to modify regular bullets instead. This adds a small operating cost to the Guncraft to ensure you have a steady supply of ammunition.

outfits.name: Leviathan Comic
outfits.description: The first issue of Drugub's comic book inspired by human ship designs. The art looks good, but you can't read Arach.

TriggeredByMissionEvents: "Metropolis Epilogue: Arachi Cartoonist" → event "Leviathan Comic Collectible"

outfits.name: Leviathan Comic #1
outfits.description: The first issue of Drugub's comic book inspired by human ship designs. The art looks good, but you can't read Arach. After a decade, this has become a rare collector's item.

outfits.name: Lionheart Sponsorship
outfits.description: As part of your sponsorship agreement, Lionheart Industries will pay 500 credits per day when you use this ship. 	(Operating income will not be paid while this ship is parked.)

outfits.name: Melchior Post Card
outfits.description: An old fashioned post card with a photo depicting Melchior on the day it was launched from the Old Port on Zug.

outfits.name: Microwave Cannon
outfits.description: Papa Grudge's custom weapon. It emits a cone of blistering heat, making it difficult for the enemy to maintain a defensive position. While not immediately lethal, prolonged exposure can cause blindness, disfigurement, and ultimately leads to a slow and agonizing death. This sort of weapons modification violates several consumer safety laws and regulations, so don't expect to find one of these for sale at any legitimate outfitter.

outfits.name: Skeleton Key
outfits.description: Urban legends include tales of three "Skeleton Keys" that unlock a pirate treasure. Perhaps this is one of those legendary keys.

outfits.name: Syndicate Stock (Preferred)
outfits.description: This certificate represents ownership of one share of Syndicate preferred stock. As a preferred shareholder, you have voting power in shareholder elections. 	Shares of Syndicate preferred stock are no longer available for purchase. The last batch was issued over 200 years ago. The Syndicate still disburses dividends for existing shares owned by those fortunate enough to have them.

outfits.name: T.H.O.R.
outfits.description: Produced by Kraz Cybernetics, this prototype Tactical Heavy Offensive Robot is armed with a tactical laser rifle, a shoulder mounted gatling gun, and an arm mounted pile driver. An installable storage bay for charging, maintenance, and repairs is included. Combat testing of the artificial intelligence is incomplete and the mass production design has not yet been finalized. Therefore pre-orders are not being accepted at this time. When this is installed on a ship, a dedicated maintenance crew must be hired for it.

outfits.name: T.H.O.R. (Damaged)
outfits.description: Produced by Kraz Cybernetics, this prototype Tactical Heavy Offensive Robot has taken severe damage. The engineers on Rust in the Kraz system can probably repair it, but it won't be cheap. Although it is not able to be deployed, you should keep this installed on your ship to prevent it from being mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Crystal Key
outfits.description: Han Sizer purportedly acquired this object from a Quarg he encountered in the Outer Rim. Supposedly it is a key that can open a path to far flung regions of the galaxy that would otherwise be inaccessible to humanity. 	In all his travels, Han never found the door. Or perhaps he did but never shared the knowledge of what lay beyond. Most scholars familiar with the tale have concluded that some, if not all, aspects of this story are completely fabricated.

outfits.name: Deep Security License
outfits.description: That's classified.

outfits.name: Covert Mining License
outfits.description: This proves that you've been granted permission to purchase ships and outfits exclusively reserved for members of the Covert Mining Cartel and their esteemed associates.

outfits.name: Fake Pilot's License
outfits.description: This Pilot's License is a forgery. Most people won't notice, but it might set off some alarms if it is detected in a scan by Republic authorities. 	If you ever acquire a real Pilot's License, you'll automatically dispose of this one the next time you fly.

outfits.name: Inferno Dragon License
outfits.description: This secret poem is the key to access Inferno Rockets at pirate outfitters across the galaxy: 	The Inferno Dragon's claws ravage the timeless earth. 	The Inferno Dragon's presence causes all to tremble. 	The Inferno Dragon's breath boils the boundless ocean. 	The Inferno Dragon's thirst can never be quenched. 	The Inferno Dragon's wings spread across the endless sky. 	The Inferno Dragon's ambition reaches the heavens.

outfits.name: Sunracer License
outfits.description: Only pilots who've proven their skills in a timed Sunracer Qualifier can participate in Solus League races. 	Solus League races require a ship to have no crew other than the pilot and weigh less than 250 tons.

outfits.name: Solus Champion License
outfits.description: Winning first place in a Solus League race qualifies a racer to participate in Geminae League races. 	Geminae League races require a ship to have no crew other than the pilot and weigh less than 200 tons.

outfits.name: Geminae Champion License
outfits.description: Winning first place in a Geminae League race qualifies a racer to participate in Tertio League races. 	Tertio League races require a ship to have no crew other than the pilot and weigh less than 150 tons.

outfits.name: Tertio Champion License
outfits.description: Winning first place in a Tertio League race is the highest honor a Sunracer can aspire to. 	Tertio Champions are sometimes offered jobs and opportunities not available to other racing pilots.

outfits.name: Fake Pilot's License Token
outfits.description: The Fake Pilot's License is a proxy for this outfit because the game does not include licenses in outfit scans.

outfits.name: Tertio Token
outfits.description: Grants access to Checkpoint Tertio.

outfits.name: Double Anti-Missile Turret
outfits.description: The Double Anti-Missile Turret fills the role of a medium weight anti-missile weapon. Its high rate of fire makes it an ideal choice for thinning out missile swarms.

The localized cluster fire exhibited in them harkens back to this original design. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Particle Burst Turret
outfits.description: One of the most frequent product requests submitted to Lovelace Labs is for a turreted version of the Particle Cannon. While none have made it past the prototype testing phase before, this version looks promising. 	An issue with previous designs was jamming in the turret turning mechanism due to stress from the recoil. In addition to a reinforced turret mount, the Particle Burst Turret limits the rate of fire to a three shot burst. Lab results have been satisfactory so far, but actual combat testing is needed. 	This weapon is still in development and is unavailable to the general public. A few lucky pilots with connections within the company have been given access to prototypes for field testing.

outfits.description: The Inferno Rocket Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Inferno Rockets. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.description: A weapon secretly developed through cooperation between different pirate factions, Inferno Rockets splatter their targets with a highly flammable substance.

outfits.name: Stinger Missile
outfits.description: A Stinger Missile serves as ammunition for the Stinger Missile Launcher. You cannot install missiles if you have not first purchased a pod, launcher, or rack to store them in. 	Mass produced under horrendous conditions on pirate worlds, Stinger Missiles utilize outdated radar tracking technology and are also easily destroyed by anti-missile weapons. Often, the slaves assigned to manufacture them are sick or elderly. In other words, the ones too weak to fight or have low potential future value. Accidental exposure to the toxic materials in these weapons during construction is common, resulting in a high mortality rate among the laborers.

outfits.name: Stinger Missile Depot
outfits.description: The Stinger Missile Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Stinger Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Stinger Missile Launcher
outfits.description: The use of hazardous waste as a weapon has long been a popular tactic among anarchists and terrorists. Stinger Missiles are an insidious example of this. Developed during the early turf wars, the materials to make them are readily available and there is no shortage of suppliers. 	Once it splatters the target with its dangerous payload, the residue will continue to discharge the shields or corrode the hull for some time after the initial impact.

outfits.name: Stinger Missile Pod
outfits.description: The use of hazardous waste as a weapon has long been a popular tactic among anarchists and terrorists. Stinger Missiles are an insidious example of this. Developed during the early turf wars, the materials to make them are readily available and there is no shortage of suppliers. outfits.name: Twin Meteor Launcher
outfits.description: The Meteor Missile is the cheapest and simplest homing weapon available in human space, with only rudimentary infrared tracking systems that can have trouble homing in on targets with low heat levels. True to its name, the missile reaches a very high speed to leave its target's anti-missile defenses with little time to react. The trade-off is maneuverability, so Meteor Missiles are practically useless against agile targets farther than point-blank range. 	This alternative to the Meteor Missile Launcher was in common use centuries ago. With the widespread adoption of Torpedo technology, the Twin Meteor Launcher is considered an antiquated design. 	This weapon will jam if there isn't enough ammunition to fire a full volley.

At first glance this looks like a regular Torpedo Launcher. But a closer inspection reveals that these are a pair of Torpedo Pods jury rigged to be crammed into a single gunport. Both are programmed to activate simultaneously, launching a pair of Torpedoes when fired. 	This weapon will jam if there isn't enough ammunition to fire a full volley.

outfits.name: Bullet Box Depot
outfits.description: The Bullet Box Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Gatling Gun Ammo. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Plasma Cluster Cannon
outfits.description: The Plasma Charge Cannon has been modified to take advantage of concentrated firing mounts. The power and range of each shot has increased at the expense of increasing the weapon's charge up time. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Ammo Basics
outfits.description: "How Not To Blow Yourself Up: A Guide To Ammunition Development." 	This guidebook gives novice weapons developers safety tips and best practices for experimenting with ammunition. A small disclaimer indicates that this is for informational purposes only. The publisher accepts no liability for any damage, injury, or death resulting from anyone reading this book. 	Keep this installed on your flagship if you want to research ammunition technologies as you fly through the galaxy.

outfits.name: Ammo Expertise License
outfits.description: You have learned all of the basic human ammunition technologies. Perhaps this foundational knowledge might prove useful in your research endeavors. 	You must still carry a copy of Ammo Basics if you want to research new ammunition technologies.

outfits.name: Deflection Beam
outfits.description: The Deflection Beam is a variation of the Incipias' Stagnation Beam. During the time that Pon'tes was under construction this device was originally developed to stop a rogue asteroid from continuing its deadly trajectory towards a collision with the space station. Hicemus tacticians have recently concluded that this application of tractor technology could create new tactical options in space combat. 	The secret of how these beams work is only known to a few scientists of the Incipias who are under the control of the state. Such knowledge, if made public, could have disastrous consequences for the Hicemus and their grip on power.

outfits.name: Midnight FTL Prototype
outfits.description: An experimental FTL drive. It is not clear how this is activated...

outfits.name: Builder Anti-Missile
outfits.description: The Builders anti-missile technology isn't much more advanced than what is available from Lovelace Labs. In some ways they're inferior. Their range is severely limited and they have a slow recharge time. Also, these turrets require a crew member to operate them.

EventOutfitterChanges: Adds to "Viminal" via event "add Builder Anti-Missile to Remnant Salvage"

outfits.name: Builder Negator
outfits.description: A rapid fire version of the Nullifier, the Negator is so powerful that it impacts the ship it is installed on with some ionic interference. If not used with discretion, it can easily drain its own ship's power reserves and even cause its own internal mechanisms to jam. 	Attempts to train the Ka'het to use this weapon ended with disastrous results. They possessed no sense of restraint, constantly firing the Negator until their own energy storage systems ran dry.

outfits.name: Builder Grand Cooling
outfits.description: This powerful cooling system keeps large Builder ships from overheating.

outfits.name: Builder Grand Defense
outfits.description: Builder ships had weak shields, which necessitated development of strong hulls and hull repair technologies. Devices like the Grand Defense are a rarity, as the Builders only intended them to supplement the integrated hull repair on their largest ships.

outfits.name: Builder Grand Generator
outfits.description: The most powerful generator created by the Builders, the Grand Generator is reserved for installation on the largest of Builder ships.

outfits.name: Builder Grand Accumulator
outfits.description: A bank of power accumulators condensed to store vast amounts of energy for use on larger Builder ships.

outfits.name: Builder Hull Plating (100%)
outfits.description: Builder capital ships have extremely durable hulls. This enhanced hull plating allows a ship it is installed on to survive diving into the harsh atmosphere of a gas giant even if it wasn't specifically designed to do so. Relying on this too often will cause it to deteriorate.

outfits.description: This feral creature was at the top of Sarisa Fentra's natural food chain. outfits.name: Meltdown Cannon
outfits.description: A weapon stolen from Farpoint's evidence vault, this bears a resemblance to the Korath Thermal Repeater Rifle. It launches a glob of burning plasma that can melt though titanium on contact. It's possible that this is the last one of these weapons to exist. outfits.name: Seleptra Bloom
outfits.description: The Korath admire Seleptra Blooms from a distance. If a creature wanders close enough, the plant releases a cloud of spores. While not lethal to living creatures, they can induce a deep sleep that leaves its victims vulnerable to predators. If an infested creature dies, the spores inside the corpse will begin to grow. 	Spores infesting flesh processed into Nutrigel by a microbot fabricator do not survive the process, leaving a product that is safe to consume. Nutrigel made from meat infused with Seleptra Bloom spores are also more flavorful to Korath tastebuds.

outfits.name: Pug Corroder
outfits.description: The Pug Corroder creates powerful energy bolts that disrupts the polarity of electrons that bind atoms together. This effect continues to damage the target after they strike.

outfits.name: Pug Corroder Turret
outfits.description: The Pug Corroder Turret creates powerful energy bolts that disrupts the polarity of electrons that bind atoms together. This effect continues to damage the target after they strike.

outfits.name: Pug Ghost Seeker
outfits.description: The Pug Ghost Seeker has a lower rate of fire than their regular Seeker. However, its slower projectiles have the ability to phase through obstacles and are unaffected by Anti-missiles. Even shields are less effective at stopping them.

outfits.name: Pug Ghost Zapper
outfits.description: The Pug Ghost Zapper fires an invisible beam that exerts force against whatever it hits.

outfits.name: Pug Ghost Zapper Turret
outfits.description: The Pug Ghost Zapper Turret fires invisible beams that exert force against whatever it hits.

outfits.name: Pug Ion Zapper
outfits.description: This Pug Zapper has been modified to add Ionic damage to the beam it generates.

outfits.name: Pug Ion Zapper Turret
outfits.description: The Pug Ion Zapper Turret delivers twice the ionic damage of the non-turreted version.

outfits.name: Pug Dual Seeker
outfits.description: The Pug Dual Seeker mounts two Pug Seekers onto a single gun port, providing increased firepower.

outfits.name: Pug Thunder Seeker
outfits.description: The Pug Thunder Seeker fires homing energy projectiles much like the regular seeker. The difference is that these are more resilient against anti-missiles and explode more violently on impact.

outfits.name: Tier 2 Anti-Missile
outfits.description: The Pug's Tier 2 anti-missile system features both more power and a longer range with no increases in energy consumption or heat generated.

outfits.name: Jump Drive (Limit Fuel)
outfits.description: The workings of the jump drive are a total mystery. The best that human scientists have been able to find out is that this device is a containment field for matter in a state that cannot normally exist in this universe; if the drive is opened up, the field collapses and its contents disappear. Therefore, even though a few jump drives have been captured over the years, it has so far proved impossible to reverse engineer them. Damage to this Jump Drive has doubled the amount of fuel it consumes with each jump.

outfits.description: The Dream Crystal is a modified Pug Peacekeeping Staff that lacks the ability to emit a beam. Pirates have found a variety of uses for these Crystals. Some use them to control slaves while others sell them as mind altering stimulators. outfits.description: A picture of an artifact found in Earth ruins discovered under the western Sahara marshes. It depicts a crowd of prehistoric humans kneeling before a prominent figure of some importance. 	This photo is somewhat blurry, but still might be worth something to the right person...

outfits.description: Although this device is no longer functioning, it might still be worth something to the right people.

outfits.name: Celestial Compass
outfits.description: With the right mapping data, this alien device can project the movement of celestial objects across the galaxy.

outfits.name: Midnight's Lost Orphan
outfits.description: A parasitic incorporeal entity from another dimension. Midnight's Lost Orphan grants its host strange unnatural powers that can bend or warp time and space. 	However, the entity feeds on negative emotions and will manipulate the mental state of anyone nearby towards taking actions that cause strife, pain, and suffering among friend and foe alike. Crew productivity and teamwork takes a severe downturn whenever the entity is allowed to exert itself. A simple task that would normally take one crew member to perform can require two or three as tense arguments and disagreements hamper efficiency.

outfits.name: Phalanx Grenade
outfits.description: This rechargeable device is designed to be tossed at the enemy like a grenade. Instead of exploding, it sprays the enemy with bursts of laser fire until its charge runs out. It can be set as a trap to defend against boarders, but its charge doesn't last long. Although it was not made by the Quarg, stolen Quarg technology was used in its construction.

outfits.name: Quarg Graviton Generator
outfits.description: A weapon that once belonged to a rogue Quarg, the Graviton Generator causes a small singularity to appear temporarily at the distance and direction set by the wielder. Anything caught within the implosion point is instantly crushed from the extreme gravitational forces generated. Unlike traditional firearms, no projectile is actually launched from the weapon, rendering line of sight seemingly meaningless. 	Due to the potential collateral damage this weapon can cause, using it to defend your own ship from boarders is ill advised.

outfits.name: Lightning Tendril
outfits.description: A weapon inspired by the electrifying Luminazoa. The tentacle is difficult to control. The gunner must often struggle to aim at a target.

outfits.name: Flare Belcher
outfits.description: A weapon inspired by the fire breathing Nova Fireflies. An extra tank of hyperspace fuel is included.

outfits.name: Quill Launcher
outfits.description: A weapon inspired by the prickly Star Gazers. There is a slight delay while it regenerates the quills used as ammunition.

outfits.name: EMP Torpedo Storage Depot
outfits.description: The EMP Torpedo Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use EMP torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Teciimach Canister Depot
outfits.description: The Teciimach Canister Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Teciimach Canisters. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Engine Restraint
outfits.description: An Engine Restraint will reduce the mobility of any ship it is installed on. Remnant crews able to board an enemy ship may attach this device onto the enemy engine systems to sabotage their maneuverability. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Heart of Nightmare
outfits.description: The still living organ of some unknown alien creature throbs and quivers aboard the Ember Nightmare. Integrated into the ship's systems, it is not clear how this is kept alive. The system data indicates that its primary purpose involves providing the ship with a crude form of stealth via radar and optical jamming. If removed through conventional means, the organ would probably die.

outfits.name: Reverberator Rifle
outfits.description: A weapon stolen from Farpoint's evidence vault, this utilizes design concepts similar to those found in the Remant Tuning Rifle. While not as refined in its ability to pinpoint organs to liquefy, it's true potential is in the echo that grows in intensity as the soundwaves reverberate down spaceship corridors, eventually becoming strong enough to knock humans off their feet. As the sounds bounce off walls, they can even hit targets hiding behind corners. Unfortunately, this weapon is useless outside of the confines of a spaceship.

outfits.name: Void Rifle Display
outfits.description: This Void Rifle is a museuam quality display piece dating back several centuries. While the internal components no longer function, it has been well maintained by its previous owner. However as a weapon it is nothing more than a fancy club.

description.text: Closer to the poles, the air is too cold to be comfortable for the Kimek, but a small community of Saryd engineers has established a factory compound where they produce their own equipment to sell to the Kimek.

spaceport.text: This is a sparsely populated world by Kimek standards, with a population of slightly less than a billion, but by the standards of most other species the spaceport is still a crowded and chaotic metropolis, with constant streams of traffic both on the roads and on the pedestrian walkways and footbridges. It is somewhat disconcerting to be surrounded by a sea of giant beetles scurrying back and forth between the landing pads and the port buildings.

description.text: The Syndicate has a generous vacation policy on Foundry that allows workers to take as much as a month of vacation time every year, and many choose to take that time to escape from the cities and explore the wilderness. The shipyards claim that this vacation time is partly responsible for the high reliability of the ships built here, because a well-rested and relaxed worker is less likely to make the sort of mistakes that can quickly become disastrous in outer space.

spaceport.text: Everything is made of gleaming metal, and each tower is slightly tapered and adorned with painted fins that make it resemble an enormous starship.

description.text: Barren and lifeless, this rock is almost entirely uninteresting, other than higher than usual amounts of rare minerals within the crust and extreme earthquakes that rock the surface periodically.

Stormhold is a cold planet, with a dense, foggy atmosphere. As with many pirate outposts, Stormhold is home to an unknown number of villages and hidden outposts, each controlled by a different pirate faction. It is also said that some of the most dangerous fugitives in the galaxy live deep in the forests of this planet, escaping detection by living underground or by avoiding the use of electronic devices.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is a large town, with a population of roughly thirty thousand. People of all races and cultures mingle freely, while keeping a wary eye open for off-worlders who may be Republic agents in disguise.

description.text: From above, the planet looks almost lifeless and barren. Most of the major cities on Ada are built into the walls of the canyons, where they are protected from the high winds and occasional dust storms that sweep across the surface.

spaceport.text: Behind the docking caves is a bustling subterranean city where bare rock and gleaming metal have been woven together in an architecture that is both functional and elegant. The lighting in the caverns varies over the course of the day to match the sunlight outside.

description.text: Conducting any business here is a nightmare of tedium. Syndicate doctrine claims that corporate structure and process produce a leaner and more effective military force without the perceived wastage of the Republic Navy. But in practice, they seem to have combined all the worst aspects of military and corporate bureaucracy.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is mostly a military base. Uniformed crew members hurry back and forth without giving you a second glance. The food in the mess hall is standard military fare, hearty but bland and unappetizing, and there are few shops or other services catering to civilians.

description.text: Despite seeing numerous non-Quarg ships before landing on the ring, you are only guided around parts of the ring where they are not present.

spaceport.text: There are probably many hundreds of billions of Quarg on this ring, and yet it still manages to feel spacious and lightly populated. They shift past you at a normal walking pace for a Quarg, and don't give you much attention except from the occasional uninterested glance or two. There seems to be little conversation and effort to accommodate you as the only non-Quarg in sight. It seems areas containing the aliens from nearby are off-limits to you.

description.text: Many of the inhabitants are in fact not pirates, but their descendants, and these children and grand-children of anarchist outlaws have built a system of regional government that oversees hospitals, schools, and other public services, all created without funding from the Republic or taxes paid to it. The planet even sports its own shipyard, although many of the ships built here are, not surprisingly, based on designs pirated from the Syndicate and Republic shipyards.

spaceport.text: This is the sort of spaceport you picture in your head when you think of pirates. Half the storefronts are bars, and rum seems to be on the menu everywhere. It is almost like the stories of ancient Earth, except that the eye patches are cybernetic implants and the peg legs are motorized prostheses. Swarthy, dangerous-looking women glance at you as you pass by, and scantily clad men crowd around the bars, which is what you seem to remember the stories said it was like on Earth, too, although there it may have been the other way around.
